svg.text: SOP-01-landing-zone.ps1 is idempotent: a rerun converges and never duplicates. Every client value

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lives in tenant.parameters.json (never in a public repository). Run with -WhatIf first to list every

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: change, then build, then Get-AzPolicyStateSummary as the exit check.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rollback runs the order in reverse

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Locks, resource groups, policy assignments, role assignments, then management groups (move the

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: subscription back to the tenant root first). Never delete the archive storage account: an unlocked

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WORM policy still blocks deleting the data inside it until the retention ends.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Exit criterion: every subscription under the product root and Deny guardrails at 100 percent. Controls: CM-2, CM-7 (baseline and guardrails), AC-2 (group-based roles), AU-6, AU-9 (central and protected logs).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
